title: The CMA says Meta made changes to Muse's ToS in the UK to reflect the country's consumer law; the terms give users far more protections than in the US (Joseph Bambridge/Politico)
summary: Joseph Bambridge / Politico: The CMA says Meta made changes to Muse's ToS in the UK to reflect the country's consumer law; the terms give users far more protections than in the US — The U.K. terms of service for Muse give consumers far more protection than in the U.S. — LONDON — Meta will be on the hook …
contentText:
Joseph Bambridge / Politico :

The CMA says Meta made changes to Muse's ToS in the UK to reflect the country's consumer law; the terms give users far more protections than in the US   —  The U.K. terms of service for Muse give consumers far more protection than in the U.S.  —  LONDON — Meta will be on the hook …
